biggest_catch: The published price list looks like a menu, but it expires in two business days - and you pay to ship it there, with no returns on damaged items and no appeal on refused ones.
catches: You pay the outbound shipping - factor postage into whether the sale is worth it.
The printed price list is only honored if shipped within two business days; outdated lists get current (possibly lower) prices.
DKOldies reserves the right to refuse any item, transactions are final, and damaged items are not returned.
Prices are for cartridges only unless stated; disc games must be complete with case and manual for full value.
Resale catch-all: value varies by condition and demand; quotes and market prices can change; fees or shipping can reduce your actual proceeds.
